overview_description.description:
Clip the Deal is a Marketing Technology platform for tracking offline grocery retail. Available as a mobile app, Clip the Deal is a comprehensive, one stop customer engagement and data analytics platform for FMCG brands and Retailers through Digital grocery deals, Targeted sampling and Verified Ratings & Reviews.

Clip the Deal - multi-brand, multi retailer platform that acts as a single source of digital grocery deals, bridging the online and offline gap between retailers, distributors, brands and customers. 

ClipBox - Targeted sampling for FMCG brands via the ClipBox section and gather user feedback. 

Clip Reviews - Verified Ratings & Reviews platform to help Grocery Brands with Influence Marketing, the Reviews section allows users who have purchased or sampled products to rate &/or review the product
